entries.title: Numbers 28:1
segments: ¶Now the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

entries.title: Numbers 28:2
segments: "Command the children of Israel, and say to them, 'My offering, My food for My offerings made by fire as a sweet aroma to Me, you shall be careful to offer to Me at their appointed time.'

entries.title: Numbers 28:3
segments: "And you shall say to them, 'This [is] the offering made by fire which you shall offer to the LORD: two male lambs in their first year without blemish, day by day, as a regular burnt offering.

entries.title: Numbers 28:4
segments: 'The one lamb you shall offer in the morning, the other lamb you shall offer in the evening,

entries.title: Numbers 28:5
segments: 'and one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering mixed with one-fourth of a hin of pressed oil.

entries.title: Numbers 28:6
segments: '[It is] a regular burnt offering which was ordained at Mount Sinai for a sweet aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

entries.title: Numbers 28:7
segments: 'And its drink offering [shall be] one-fourth of a hin for each lamb; in a holy [place] you shall pour out the drink to the LORD as an offering.

entries.title: Numbers 28:8
segments: 'The other lamb you shall offer in the evening; as the morning grain offering and its drink offering, you shall offer [it] as an offering made by fire, a sweet aroma to the LORD.

entries.title: Numbers 28:9
segments: ¶'And on the Sabbath day two lambs in their first year, without blemish, and two-tenths [of an ephah] of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with oil, with its drink offering-

entries.title: Numbers 28:10
segments: '[this is] the burnt offering for every Sabbath, besides the regular burnt offering with its drink offering.

entries.title: Numbers 28:11
segments: 'At the beginnings of your months you shall present a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, and seven lambs in their first year, without blemish;

entries.title: Numbers 28:12
segments: 'three-tenths [of an ephah] of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with oil, for each bull; two-tenths [of an ephah] of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with oil, for the one ram;

entries.title: Numbers 28:13
segments: 'and one-tenth [of an ephah] of fine flour, mixed with oil, as a grain offering for each lamb, as a burnt offering of sweet aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

entries.title: Numbers 28:14
segments: 'Their drink offering shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, one-third of a hin for a ram, and one-fourth of a hin for a lamb; this [is] the burnt offering for each month throughout the months of the year.

entries.title: Numbers 28:15
segments: 'Also one kid of the goats as a sin offering to the LORD shall be offered, besides the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.

entries.title: Numbers 28:16
segments: ¶'On the fourteenth day of the first month [is] the Passover of the LORD.

entries.title: Numbers 28:17
segments: 'And on the fifteenth day of this month [is] the feast; unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days.

entries.title: Numbers 28:18
segments: 'On the first day [you shall have] a holy convocation. You shall do no customary work.

entries.title: Numbers 28:19
segments: 'And you shall present an offering made by fire as a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, and seven lambs in their first year. Be sure they are without blemish.

entries.title: Numbers 28:20
segments: 'Their grain offering shall be of fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths [of an ephah] you shall offer for a bull, and two-tenths for a ram;

entries.title: Numbers 28:21
segments: 'you shall offer one-tenth [of an ephah] for each of the seven lambs;

entries.title: Numbers 28:22
segments: 'also one goat [as] a sin offering, to make atonement for you.

entries.title: Numbers 28:23
segments: 'You shall offer these besides the burnt offering of the morning, which [is] for a regular burnt offering.

entries.title: Numbers 28:24
segments: 'In this manner you shall offer the food of the offering made by fire daily for seven days, as a sweet aroma to the LORD; it shall be offered besides the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.

entries.title: Numbers 28:25
segments: 'And on the seventh day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no customary work.

entries.title: Numbers 28:26
segments: 'Also on the day of the firstfruits, when you bring a new grain offering to the LORD at your [Feast of] Weeks, you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no customary work.

entries.title: Numbers 28:27
segments: 'You shall present a burnt offering as a sweet aroma to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, and seven lambs in their first year,

entries.title: Numbers 28:28
segments: 'with their grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths [of an ephah] for each bull, two-tenths for the one ram,

entries.title: Numbers 28:29
segments: 'and one-tenth for each of the seven lambs;

entries.title: Numbers 28:30
segments: '[also] one kid of the goats, to make atonement for you.

entries.title: Numbers 28:31
segments: 'Be sure they are without blemish. You shall present [them] with their drink offerings, besides the regular burnt offering with its grain offering.
